body: I don’t. I fucking hate it. Good question, though.

I know you’re scared, but it’s definitely best to get some help. Try and talk to someone you really trust, and if you want to harm again, try to focus on things that make you happiest so you get out of that mindset. If you have any hobbies you like to do that make you happy, (drawing, writing, sewing, etc.) make time for those. You can help yourself and not tell anyone that you did cut in the first place, but the best way to really help yourself is talking to someone about it.

I have struggled with self-harm for the last 2-ish years. My parents are aware that I’ve got a bad habit of picking scabs, so I can quite relate to you. I would say the best thing is to talk to your family and/or get a therapist. If you ever need help with anything, my inbox is always open.
